mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: 3DPMP (3D Printing Model Platform) is dedicated to creating the ultimate marketplace for 3D printing enthusiasts, designers, and businesses. We connect creators with customers, making it easy to share, discover, and print amazing 3D models.

offer.title: What We Offer
offer.marketplaceDesc: Browse thousands of high-quality 3D models from talented creators worldwide.

team.title: Our Team
team.description: We are a passionate team of engineers, designers, and 3D printing enthusiasts committed to advancing the world of digital fabrication. Founded in 2025, 3DPMP continues to innovate and expand the possibilities of 3D printing technology.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our platform.

formats.q: What file formats do you support?
formats.a: We primarily support STL files, which is the most common format for 3D printing. We also accept OBJ and 3MF files.

slicing.q: How does the automatic slicing work?
slicing.a: When you upload or view a model, our system automatically calculates print parameters including estimated print time, material usage, and weight. This uses industry-standard slicer algorithms.

sell.q: Can I sell my own 3D models?
sell.a: Yes! You can upload your own 3D models to our marketplace and set your own prices. We take a small commission on each sale to cover platform costs.

materials.q: What materials are available for printing?
materials.a: We offer PLA, PETG, ABS, and various specialty materials. Each material has different properties suitable for different applications.

shipping.a: Print times vary based on model complexity. After printing, standard shipping typically takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping options are also available.

refunds.a: Yes, we offer full refunds for defective prints. For digital model purchases, refunds are handled case-by-case. Please contact support for assistance.
